messages.content: How has my tech fund done against its benchmark since inception?

reply.answer:
Ravi Tech Opportunities has beaten the NIFTY50 since inception. From 2016-02-29 to 2026-04-08, the fund returned 376.34% in total, versus 241.28% for the NIFTY50. The fund's lead is 135.06%.

On an annualised basis, the fund's CAGR was 16.69%, against 12.90% for the NIFTY50.

These are price returns (dividends not included) for both the fund and the index. The stock universe is today's index members, which introduces survivorship bias and flatters any comparison with the index, so the outperformance is likely overstated.

---
*Figures are computed from synthetic portfolios on real NSE prices (price returns; dividends not included). This is not investment advice.*

messages.content: Which stocks made it the most money over the last year?

reply.answer:
Over 2025-04-09 to 2026-04-08, the biggest earner in Ravi Tech Opportunities was ETERNAL, followed by LTM, TECHM and HCLTECH. These are the only four stocks that made money. P&L is based on price returns (dividends not included).

| Stock | P&L (INR) |
|---|---|
| ETERNAL | 15,66,442 |
| LTM | 10,13,151 |
| TECHM | 8,86,928 |
| HCLTECH | 4,68,974 |

The other five stocks lost money, with WIPRO the worst at about 31.46 lakh lost. Overall, the portfolio's stock P&L over the period was -₹45.19 lakh, so these gains were outweighed by the losses.

---
*Figures are computed from synthetic portfolios on real NSE prices (price returns; dividends not included). This is not investment advice.*
